samples.stimulus: A random sample of shoppers was asked whether they bring their own bags. The number line shown gives the plausible interval for the percent of all shoppers at a downtown market who bring their own bags. The interval is the sample percent plus or minus the margin of error. A larger study keeps the same sample percent but doubles the margin of error. Answer the question using only the number line shown.
samples.question: What is the greatest plausible percent in the new interval?
samples.explanation: (1) 수직선에서 구간의 두 끝을 읽는다: 72% ~ 80%. (2) 표본 % = 76%, 오차범위 = 4 이다. (3) 새 오차범위 = 2 × 4 = 8 이다. (4) 새 위 끝 = 76 + 8 = 84 이다. (5) 따라서 답은 84 이다. 따라서 정답은 84이다.
